answer: The system gives weight only to identities signed by a hardware attestation key sealed inside one separate device, so each fake needs its own device whose key cannot be copied. Activation is checked in person: the device is set on a basalt slab, a 10-gram umber sample sealed in its case is weighed, and the owner carries it across a 30-meter terrace in one timed trip while its key signs. A sample off by more than 0.1 gram or a reused key fails and zeroes weight for 90 days, so 100 fakes need 100 devices.
